doc.name: BeevR Assistant
doc.description: BeevR is a founder-led software and frontier-AI studio in Hanoi, Vietnam. It builds production AI agents, AI-native MVPs (fixed price) and HIPAA/PCI-compliant software. This endpoint gives read-only access to its services, pricing, shipped case studies and articles. Send a question as text; the agent replies with matching services, case studies, articles or pricing (read-only, deterministic, no LLM).

skills.name: Find BeevR expertise
skills.description: Answers questions about what BeevR builds (AI agents, AI-native MVPs, HIPAA/PCI software, offshore development in Vietnam) with matching services, shipped case studies and articles.
examples: Can BeevR build a HIPAA-compliant AI agent?
Show me BeevR case studies about AI
Có bài nào về chi phí làm MVP không?

skills.name: BeevR pricing
skills.description: Returns BeevR fixed-price packages (Pitch Demo $4K, Investor MVP $18K, Flagship Sprint $38K) with durations and inclusions.
examples: How much does an MVP with BeevR cost?
What is included in the Investor MVP package?
